```plato
//==
// # Fields
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - IField interfaces
//  - Differentiable field interfaces
//  - Time-varying field interfaces

//==
// # IField interfaces
//
// The root IField capability and the point-domain field interfaces built on it:
// scalar, vector, direction, color, complex, and tensor fields over the plane
// and over space. Every field is IProcedural over a point domain, so curves,
// easings, and fields share one evaluation vocabulary. Concrete field types
// (noise, SDFs, sampled grids) implement the interfaces declared here; the
// derived bodies live in `fields-implicits.library.plato`.
// See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scalar_field and
// https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vector_field.

// A pure mapping from positions in a domain to values in a range. The root
// capability for every spatial field; evaluation is side-effect free and
// deterministic for a given field value.
interface IField<TDomain, TValue>
    inherits IProcedural<TDomain, TValue>
{ }
```
